logic.description: Implemented 2026-10-29. A Time permanent (power = placement die) that takes a second effect card from my hand (the one I clicked; else the one with most elements) and keeps it as a permanent effect: it re-fires every action with my current stats, for free, as long as Blessing stands (no concentration to break). Selecting Blessing again with another card replaces the first (old to the discard pile). Destroyed under Rule 24 → the attached card goes to the graveyard. ∀ (user ruling 2026-10-30): with TWO Blessing / Curse permanents, the second is spent — to my discard pile — the moment an enemy effect is about to touch me (damage, a lock, a penalty token, a forced move, an affliction, a possession, a hand peek, a trap) and that part of the effect is negated; one negation per action.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
A second effect card from the hand is attached (cast.attach); without one the cast fizzles.

effects.description: Attached effect cards that re-fire each action while Blessing stands.
Rule 24 threshold of the permanent: the kept point-buy die of its placement.
Rule 24: an adjacent enemy emitting the matching stat destroys this permanent when their highest die is at least its power.
∀: the second Blessing negates one hostile effect on its holder and is spent.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_time (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
